newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-Harley-Davidson raised to buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Harley-Davidson raised to buy.

text.p: -- Dain Bosworth Inc said Monday it raised its rating on Harley-Davidson Inc to buy from hold, based on valuation, enhanced earnings expectations and continued production expansion.
-- Last week, the motorcycle manufacturer reported fourth quarter operating earnings of $0.49 a share, a penny above Dain Bosworth's estimate. Full 1996 earnings were $1.90 a share.
-- Dain Bosworth raised its 1997 estimate to $2.25 a share from $2.20 and initiated a $2.65 a share estimate for 1998.
-- Twelve-month price target is $52, analyst Mark Leslie wrote in a research report. The stock was down 1/4 at 42-1/8 Monday afternoon.

-- "Given the overwhelming demand for Harley-Davidson motorcycles, future sales and earnings growth is almost entirely prduction-driven," Leslie said. "With an average 18-month waiting list and used bikes often selling at premiums to new models, Harley has been slowly expanding production to feed this enviable over-demand situation."
